# Golden Corpus expectations (ADR-041 D8, issue #959).
# The PDFs themselves are confidential third-party IP and must never enter Git;
# they live in the GDrive fixture folder that the nightly workflow reads. This
# manifest is the ONE place that states what "the corpus" means, so a local run
# and a CI run assert exactly the same thing:
#   AI_EVAL_CORPUS_DIR=~/Downloads/drive-download \
#     cargo test -p infra --test ai_document_eval_corpus -- --nocapture
# Format: TAB-separated `file  kind  scenes  note  cast`.
#   kind   = script   → the zone-aware segmentation must produce exactly `scenes`
#                       scene chunks, no continuation banner, and no
#                       SceneIndex-vs-body drift.
#            schedule → a shooting schedule: the script segmentation assertions
#                       do not apply (it is read by the schedule worker).
#   scenes = expected scene-chunk count for a script, ignored for a schedule.
#   cast   = comma-separated `name:category` assertions (`main_cast|guest|extra`)
#            resolved through the deterministic #961 ladder against that
#            document's parsed CastDirectory; `-` means no cast assertion.
# Every listed file MUST be present in AI_EVAL_CORPUS_DIR once the variable is
# set: a partial corpus is a failure, not a silent skip. Extra PDFs in the
# directory are still checked structurally (they just carry no count
# expectation).
